note: passed = the type has a measured gate and an external referent that agreed; failed = measured and missed; no_referent = no gate or no outside reference has been run. Only passed types may carry a confirmed tier.

binary_classification.scope: class-conditional prediction sets (simulation); no real-data referent run (G7)

multiclass_classification.scope: class-conditional prediction sets (simulation); no real-data referent run (G7)

regression.scope: marginal split and CV+ coverage (simulation); CQR conditional coverage failed G3

survival.scope: IPCW simulation passed; scikit-survival/R differential (G11ii) not run; no interval

ranking.scope: query bootstrap implemented; public LTR set (G10) not run; no interval

multilabel.scope: no per-label sets or support rule (G12 not built)

forecast.scope: proper scores implemented; M4/M5 reproduction (G8) not run; no interval

uplift.scope: no observed individual effect, so no coverage target
